evidence_items.explanation: Cursor confirms substantial cost differences between requests while reporting broadly stable costs for most users. This supports caution about token consumption but does not establish either an industry-wide rise or fall.

OpenAI reports lower median-query costs for a newer model. This challenges an unrestricted denial of cost reductions, but its typical query assumptions do not measure spending across representative applications.

unresolved_gaps: No representative longitudinal application billing dataset was found that controls for completed work, quality, task difficulty, and model choice.
The cited examples do not establish how common rising or falling application costs were.
The claim supplies no weighting rule for combining different applications into a general trend.
